lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots along the mid-lateral flank, forming a grid-like array with approximately equidistant spacing between vertical rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal ridges to form anchor points for the primary high-luminance spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a light-to-dark vertical luminance gradient running longitudinally across the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of smaller high-luminance spots distributed across the surface of the visible pectoral fin.
